admin.webhooks.help: The organisation's tools (CRM, monitoring, ticketing) receive the telephony's events: calls ringing, answered, ended, missed, presences, trunks degraded then recovered. Each delivery is signed (X-TwakePhone-Signature header) and retried up to 8 times when it fails; the event's id is its idempotency key. They may arrive out of order: sort on occurred_at.

admin.err.operatorLineShared: Another trunk keeps another fallback forward on one of these lines: a line has one forward.
admin.err.operatorNoLines: This trunk has no line at the operator.
admin.trunk.err.replaceConfirmed: Tick this box to replace what is set at the operator on these lines.
admin.trunk.replaceConfirmed: Replace what is set at the operator on these lines
admin.trunk.replaceHint: What the operator's customer area sets on these lines is replaced by this forward when saved.
admin.trunk.readOperator: Read what is set at the operator
admin.trunk.deleteConfirmOperator: Delete trunk {id} and its direct numbers? The fallback forward it keeps at the operator will be removed from its lines.
admin.operator.remove: Remove the forward at the operator
admin.operator.removeOf: Remove the fallback forward of trunk {id} at the operator
admin.operator.removeConfirm: Remove the fallback forward of the lines of trunk {id} at the operator? The platform will no longer keep it.
admin.operator.removed: The fallback forward of trunk {id} was removed at the operator.
admin.operator.err.conflict: two trunks ask two different forwards on this line: nothing is set
admin.operator.rejected: the operator did not keep this setting: save the trunk to try again
admin.operator.statRateHint: Share of the calls recorded that the platform had too: those received by the operator only, those it forwarded, those erased with a history and those not reconciled yet do not count.
admin.operator.removedPending: Trunk {id} no longer keeps a fallback forward, but the operator has not removed it from {lines} yet: the platform tries again at each round.
admin.trunk.deletedPending: Trunk {id} deleted. The operator has not removed its fallback forward from {lines} yet: the platform tries again at each round.
admin.operator.removals: Forwards not removed at the operator yet
admin.operator.removalsHelp: The platform tries again at each round, even for a deleted trunk, until the line is as it was before it. What an administrator changed meanwhile in the operator's manager is left as it is, and a line the operator no longer knows three rounds in a row is let go: each raises an alert, as does a removal owed for over a day.
admin.operator.removeConfirmSet: Remove the forwards set at the operator on the lines of trunk {id}? Those another trunk keeps stay.
admin.trunk.operatorDropped: When saved, the fallback forward this trunk keeps will be removed at the operator from: {lines}.
admin.trunk.fallbackLeft: Unticked, the forward set stays at the operator on {lines}: “Remove the forward at the operator”, in the list of trunks, removes it.
admin.trunk.operatorNowNew: Set at the operator now, on the lines this trunk does not keep yet
admin.err.operatorRound: The operator could not be read, or not in time: the figures shown are those of the previous round.
admin.operator.restoreUnknown: Line {line}: its forwards from before the platform are not known, they will not be put back.
admin.operator.restoreLine: Line {line}: its forwards from before the platform will be put back ({forwards}).
admin.operator.restoreOther: Line {line}: its forwards from before the platform ({forwards}) go where it cannot write, they will not be put back.
admin.operator.abandonOf: Let go of the removal of the forward of line {line}
admin.operator.abandonConfirm: Let go of the removal of the forward of line {line}? The platform will write nothing more there, and what is set at the operator stays.
admin.operator.abandoned: Removal on line {line} let go: what is set there at the operator stays.
admin.operator.closed.restored: Line {line}: forward removed on {at}, its forwards from before put back
admin.operator.closed.changed: Line {line}: changed in the operator's manager since it was asked, left as it is on {at}
admin.operator.closed.gone: Line {line}: unknown to the operator, removal let go on {at}
admin.operator.closed.abandoned: Line {line}: removal let go by an administrator on {at}
admin.trunk.savedPending: Trunk {id} saved. The operator has not removed its fallback forward from {lines} yet: the platform tries again at each round.
admin.alert.operatorRemovalChanged: The forward of a line changed at the operator since its removal was asked: left as it is
admin.alert.operatorRemovalGone: Removal of a forward let go: the operator no longer knows the line
admin.alert.voicemailSyncFailing: The mailboxes are no longer synchronised with the voicemail server (minutes of failure)
admin.alert.voicemailSyncFenced: The SIP server refused a write of the mailboxes made under an older lease than its last one: see the documentation to reset its fence
admin.alert.voicemailBoxesRefused: Mailboxes the voicemail server keeps refusing to create or change (how many)
admin.alert.voicemailHiddenCalls: Callers with no number at their cap of calls at the same time to this mailbox
admin.alert.voicemailHiddenHour: Callers with no number at their cap of calls in the hour to this mailbox
admin.alert.voicemailHiddenAll: Callers with no number at their cap of calls at the same time to all the mailboxes
admin.alert.voicemailCallsAll: All the places of calls to the mailboxes taken: callers get what they would have had without a mailbox
admin.alert.voicemailHeldBack: Mailboxes held back: too many people without an extension at once (or a directory id changed); an administrator confirms it through /api/v1/admin/voicemail (how many, of how many). Confirmed, they are set aside with their messages, given back to whoever holds an extension again within VOICEMAIL_GRACE_DAYS of absence (the time held back does not count)
admin.alert.voicemailWaiting: {waiting} new holder(s) without a mailbox until the release
admin.alert.voicemailOff: voicemail off for the whole tenant: no extension reaches a mailbox
admin.alert.voicemailHeldBackRemove: Mailboxes past their grace period kept: too many to remove at once; an administrator confirms it through /api/v1/admin/voicemail (how many). Confirmed, their removal cannot be undone
admin.alert.operatorRemovalLate: The forward of a line owed to be removed at the operator for over a day
admin.operator.restoreRefused.loop: Line {line}: its forwards from before the platform ({forwards}) will not be put back: they would bring the calls back to the platform.
admin.operator.restoreRefused.outbound: Line {line}: its forwards from before the platform ({forwards}) will not be put back: they go to a number its trunk does not call.
admin.operator.closed.unrestored.loop: Line {line}: forward removed on {at}, its forwards from before not put back (they would bring the calls back to the platform)
admin.operator.closed.unrestored.outboun: Line {line}: forward removed on {at}, its forwards from before not put back (a number its trunk does not call)
admin.operator.closed.unrestored.refused: Line {line}: forward removed on {at}, its forwards from before not put back (the operator did not keep them as they were)
voicemail.transcriptTooLong: none, the message is too long to be transcribed.
voicemail.transcriptBusy: none, too many messages were waiting for theirs.
voicemail.transcriptFailed: none, the transcription service could not transcribe it.
admin.alert.voicemailTranscriptionBusy: Too many messages were waiting for their transcription: the next ones are not transcribed (how many at most)
admin.alert.voicemailTranscriptionFailed: The transcription service (LinTO) could not transcribe a message after several tries
admin.alert.voicemailNoticeFailed: The bot could not send the notice of a message to Twake Chat after several tries
voicemail.transcriptUntracked: none, this message was not taken in hand by the transcription.
admin.alert.voicemailTranscriptionBacklo: Transcriptions or notices have been waiting for more than 30 minutes (how many): the transcription service or the Matrix server does not answer
admin.alert.voicemailNoticeNoAccount: The bot knows no Matrix account to send the notice of a message to (how many since the start): see LDAP_ATTR_MATRIX or MATRIX_USER_TEMPLATE
admin.alert.voicemailNoticeNotWithdrawn: Notices of erased messages stay in Twake Chat: the bot is no longer set up to withdraw them (how many)
admin.alert.voicemailTranscriptionHeld: Mailboxes read empty, or too many messages went at once (how many): no transcription erased, no notice withdrawn. Either the voicemail server no longer sees its message folder, or the messages were really deleted while no event was heard (from the phone, during a restart). Check that the voicemail server sees its messages; if it does, an administrator confirms it with /api/v1/admin/voicemail/transcripts/release (how many, of how many, as /api/v1/admin/voicemail gives them): only those rows are then erased, and their notices withdrawn, after two reads apart that still do not see them
admin.alert.voicemailTranscriptionUnread: Mailboxes have not been readable for several passes (how many): their missed messages are not caught up
admin.err.siteLimit: The maximum number of sites is reached.
admin.site.help: A site is a place of the organisation: its address, the number an emergency call of its people presents (a number of the trunk that the operator tied to that address) and those people. Without a site, an emergency call presents the person's direct number, then the trunk's.
admin.site.noTrunk: Add a trunk first: a site's number is a number of its trunk.
admin.site.deleteConfirm: Delete site {id}? Its people will present their direct number again.
admin.site.name: Name
admin.site.addressHint: The one the operator tied to the number below.
admin.site.numberHint: A direct number of this trunk or its default number, for example +33 1 99 00 03 50.
admin.site.membersHint: A person is in one site at most: one added here leaves their former site.
admin.site.err.id: The identifier: lower case letters, digits and dashes, 32 at most, no dash first.
admin.site.err.idTaken: A site has this identifier already: edit it from the list.
admin.site.err.name: A name of 64 characters at most, on one line.
admin.site.err.address: An address of 200 characters at most, on one line.
admin.site.err.number: A full number with its country code, for example +33 1 99 00 03 50.
admin.site.err.numberTrunk: This number is neither a direct number of this trunk nor its default number: the operator would take no other as the caller.
admin.site.err.member: One of these people is no longer in the directory: reload the page.
admin.site.err.members: A list of people of the directory, each once.
settings.emergency.title: Emergency calls
settings.emergency.site: Your emergency calls (15, 17, 18, 112…) leave from the site {name} ({address}), with the number {number}: the operator passes the address of that site to the emergency services.
settings.emergency.none: No site is assigned to you: your emergency calls present your direct number, otherwise the organisation's, and the operator passes the address it knows for it. Ask an administrator to attach you to your site.
settings.emergency.error: Your emergency site cannot be read right now.
admin.site.numberRings: This is the number the emergency services call back: it must ring someone at the site (a reception desk, a phone), not one person. The caller's direct number is not presented for an emergency when they are in a site.
admin.err.trunkHasSites: This trunk carries sites: delete them, or move them to another trunk, before deleting it.
admin.err.siteNumberInUse: A site presents this number for its emergencies: change the number of the site first.
admin.site.err.numberRings: This number rings nobody: choose a direct number of this trunk that leads to an extension or a group.
